_readme: Edit this file to update the curated calendar. Set status to 'live' once real sales replace the samples. Fields: date (ISO, used for sorting), dateLabel (what readers see), sale, house, city, url, note (one line of your own judgement), flag (short tag), flagUrgent (true renders it in vermilion, use for deadlines only).

sales.note: Domestic sale. No remittance and no import duty for Indian residents.
Check export status on any Navratna lot before you register.
Sterling settlement. Budget the remittance before the estimate, not after.
